senses.en: an Italian food made from flour and water, often formed into shapes and boiled
senses.zh: 意大利面食；由面粉和水制成、常做成各种形状并煮熟的食品

example.en: She cooked pasta for dinner and added tomato sauce.
example.zh: 她晚餐煮了意大利面，还加了番茄酱。

senses.en: an area of the body that has become larger, or the condition of becoming swollen

example.en: She had a painful swelling on her ankle.
example.zh: 她脚踝上有一处疼痛的肿块。

senses.en: becoming larger or greater in size or amount
senses.zh: 不断扩大的；日益增加的

example.en: The swelling crowd moved toward the stage.
example.zh: 不断增多的人群向舞台移动。
